notes.title: RESULTS OF 2024 AND PLANS
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/8576dcf05bf09b47b06c1b6a378e0a764cc0b25f.png

Hello everyone!

Let me share a bit about the year’s results and plans for the next one.

The year was challenging—one might even say unsuccessful—but I’ve managed to make some progress, however small.

You can follow the news on my Reddit community. There, I also occasionally write about the creation process and share more details about the Savvarah universe.

Everything will be divided into two sections: [RESULTS] and [PLANS].

RESULTS:

1. The release of Legends of Savvarah: The Time of the Pariah.
LINK

This year marked the release of a completed game set in the world of Savvarah.

Overall, I consider it a failure, but having a release is still an achievement.

Why do I see it as a failure?

- Several questionable creative decisions, less-than-ideal variability, and other choices. I don’t think it’s bad, but my expectations were a bit different.
- Financial disappointment. Even considering the significant chunk lost to U.S. taxes (due to the lack of a double taxation agreement), I managed to cover all direct expenses. However, my expectations were higher.

If you enjoyed the game, leaving a review would mean a lot.
If not… well, then don’t bother. :D

PLANS

1. Legends of Savvarah: Children of the Sun.
LINK.

The game will be released on January 23, 2024.

I've written a lot about the project in my reports, but let's break it down point by point:

- We'll find ourselves in Savvarah long before Hasvah from Gods of Savvarah was born. The war with the Horned Ones has just ended, and Akotal has not yet become a semi-divine tyrant.

- This is a technical step forward. We've got full map navigation and relatively free interactions with characters.

- A single playthrough will be significantly longer than The Time of the Pariah. Despite this, the game still retains its strong variability.

- There’s a lot of universe lore. You'll dive deep into cosmology while exploring the personal stories of the characters.

P.S. Sorry, the screenshots aren't translated yet—I'm still in the process of adding translations to the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/608ab64d66843db9ddddb197a8899cbe5cd4c0b4.png

2. Legends of Savvarah: Flowers and Scorpions.
LINK.
Scheduled for release in May 2025, though it might be delayed to June/July 2025.
It’s already well-developed but still needs assembly. Plus, I’m polishing the text to fix logical inconsistencies.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/47c26596dde695fa7de6239156797615b656d278.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/776fb2b63397e9907a3a7cbb05c45e2144e8b2ba.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/62e07567803948f512c3523a06efe2357afab307.jpg

3. DLC for Legends of Savvarah: The Time of the Pariah.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/e887bf82e415c27885e8772cd59317bd65616633.jpg
A significant DLC is planned for June 2025.

For those who already own the game, it will be free. Details will follow next year, but here’s a preview:

- Expanded introduction to the story.
- More content around the Honey House and its residents. Expect more Viory and Otkor.
- Two new characters, including the Honey House’s Mistress.
- More Sudu, more Red Shiv.

Two more projects definitely won’t be released next year, but work on them is slowly progressing behind the scenes.

4. Legends of Savvarah: Whisper. of The Ocean.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/99569e580aa6d9fb79596f92751d70f5f72ecdf8.jpg
It is planned to be a game with turn-based combat (not card-based), where you’ll have the opportunity to assemble a team—yes, much like in traditional RPGs. The setting is the tropical Ankar Archipelago.

The main character featured on the cover/banner is Atahira. Below is her image, along with one of the potential team members.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/3d825aa8b6a5964569d604332b1bf34d3f211728.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/5c877e57ede268aed2aa7ff5496685c06e47dd4e.jpg

5. Legends of Savvara: Arachnum.
Arachnum is a province of the Julian Empire, where the dominant race is the Zkitani (insectoids).

The story takes place on Ertheon (the continent of beastfolk), over 800 years after the events of "The Time of the Pariah", when the war between the Dominion and Kradjan had long since ended. The remnants of Kradjan are now only the Aquatic Tigonia, while Ertheon is under the control of the Julian Empire (the Dominion’s successor).

Matius is a judge. He comes from a noble family of beastfolk. His father holds a prominent position in the Imperial Custoria (the local Presidential Administration), his brother is a deputy minister, and his grandfather was a city prefect and a high-ranking military officer.

Matius is appointed as the new Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of Arachnum, a province inhabited by insectoids.

It’s too early to say exactly what the game will be like, but conceptually, I’m drawing inspiration from Dave the Diver.

This is a narrative-driven adventure. You’ll play as a judge, resolving disputes and navigating between the Empire and the interests of the local nobility. Along the way, you’ll explore maps, engage in mini-games, and build relationships with other characters (yes, romantic interests are planned, including beastfolk, insectoids, and Takur).

The protagonist (yes, he’s a feline humanoid) will be joined by several characters you’ll encounter along the way:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/051c18ab7dcf65a03f1de349ca037836eb9df3c1.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/7283c29d8afb18586776d25a459d3f2a35a8937b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/23a1af96e2009897989a1532f74f0cc029a96e72.jpg

Thank you for reading all the way to the end.

I hope the next year will be productive. If you’d like to support me, feel free to leave a comment here. I read everything everywhere. :)

Happy upcoming holidays! :)

notes.title: Big Report 2024
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/13effc10a082539b1b808ecc5da058f35e5e0822.jpg

Hello everyone!
Today’s update is a big one. We’ll cover what’s happened and what’s in our plans.
Thanks for keeping up with the news!

You can subscribe to my subreddit, where I post various news, dev logs, and other content. There’s also a detailed description of the world of Savvarah and a few words about my creative journey.

1. This year, “Time of Pariah” was released.
Link to the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/9a5badba55d02ed9c3fb33649c4bef9ab5263b90.png
On the positive side, the game covered direct costs, though overall it brought in far less than expected, so I consider it a failure. “Time of Pariah” was an experiment for me, but it was, in many ways, unsuccessful.

- The extensive branching diluted the story and shortened the time it took to complete any single path.
 - Combining 18+ content with a game where that content wasn’t central also wasn’t the best idea.

Still, we’re considering a major free update with new characters and expanded storylines, but we’re undecided. A final decision will be made around February or March next year.

2. “Children of the Sun.”
Link to the game page.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/4b510abe5362833d6f9f8b8ecd2e3ddd9bd0b28f.png
In January 2025, we plan to release a new game set in the world of Savvarah, and we’re on track to meet the timeline.

In my opinion, we’ve fixed many “issues” from “Time of Pariah” in this game: the branching is still extensive, but each story path takes significantly longer to complete. “Children of the Sun” has more of a fantasy tone, with magic, divine entities, and, as with my previous games, is just as dark and harsh toward the main character. I hope you’ll enjoy it. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/ffd49ba96a12d37c13043ab47b5426b14c9db047.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/bf1db124466b31ac1a662cd34b8379100a9e5695.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/9392adfc7092bc2ed8acfa66931a93e75f6be795.png

3. “Flowers and Scorpions.”
Link to the game page.
A new visual novel in the world of Savvarah is scheduled for release in May 2025. A small delay is possible, though unlikely.

4. Stickers!
If you use Telegram, you can get stickers featuring characters from Savvarah here: Link.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/f1ac8aa68490a21d3baaac5cb058d9b11abc7f4c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/02c4068ffe759867d939ccabbdc2f5bbbbac0c33.png

5. Future Plans

5.1. Untitled Project #1 (Arachnum).
There are plans for two projects that will move away from the visual novel format. Both are in the VERY early stages of development.

Here’s the gist: Arachnum is a province of the Julian Empire, where the native race is the insectoid Zkitane.

The story is set on Ertheon, over 800 years after “Time of Pariah,” after the Dominion and Kradjan war ended long ago. All that remains of Kradjan is Aquatic Tigonia, while Ertheon is under Julian Empire control (the Dominion’s successor).

Matius is a judge from a noble family of beastfolk. His father holds a high position in the Imperial Custaincy (the Imperial Administration), his brother is a deputy minister, and his grandfather was a city prefect and high-ranking military officer.

Matius is appointed as the new Chief Justice of Arachnum, a province inhabited by insectoids.

It’s too early to say what the final game will be like, but in my mind, I’m aiming for something inspired by “Dave the Diver.”

It’s a story-driven adventure. You’ll be a judge, resolving disputes, navigating between the Empire and the local nobility’s interests, exploring the map, playing mini-games, and forming relationships with other characters (yes, romantic interests will include beastfolk, insectoids, and Takur). {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/051c18ab7dcf65a03f1de349ca037836eb9df3c1.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/60992bdbd906942a0ce306db1b7c95b33a913acd.jpg

5.2. Untitled Project #2 (“Beach Episode”).
This project is an attempt at a simple RPG with turn-based combat (something similar to Darkest Dungeon). The mechanics are still in development.

We already have some experience creating similar games and plan to build on that. The game will feature a main heroine and a party with whom you’ll battle in turn-based combat and interact to build relationships.

We’re calling it the “Beach Episode” because it takes place on tropical islands.

Here’s the main heroine:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/015c7bea76ff4e5ef10162cabb8e4ed4d754115a.jpg

And a few potential party members:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/6f176a7f3418187dd005fc8f7fcfefd4d81042b1.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/9060624f9f0fe9fee3c1ecf28796d07d91db7a11.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/90c19c1f163a9583251919b894ef6cea24458e1b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/17a6069601a51aaa35a00af3ec84aa28d55099b6.jpg

Additional: A book set in the world of Savvarah has been released, though I currently don’t have the rights to translate or share it, so for now, it’s just a “by the way.”

Thank you for your attention. I hope everything works out.

If you like what I’m doing, feel free to leave feedback or… well, just let me know. I’d appreciate it! :)

notes.title: Work Report № 7 from March 08, 2024 (public)
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Thank you for following our work.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/b4567f4081c9787df81233625bb007904ceede5a.png

This is Report #7. The information is up-to-date as of the end of February 2024. A slightly more detailed report has been published on our Patreon. (including sketches, but only sketches, 18+ scenes).

You can follow us in Twitter, as well as Reddit.

The beginning of the year has been incredibly busy. Because of this, I even thought that perhaps it would be worth giving up on reports, but on the other hand, someone is reading them. And it's kind of nice to show the results of our work.

I remind you again that several projects set in the world of Savvarah are in production. And this is a report about the work on them. "Gods of Savvarah," unfortunately, are still on hold.

1. "Time of Pariah".

Add to wishlist. 

Most importantly: the likelihood that they will be released in August 2024 is very high (I would say 90 percent), because we are moving towards this very confidently.

What's happening:

    1. We have started translating the text into English.
    2. I began assembling the game's code.
    3. The music is ready, so we decided to make additional tracks.
    4. The game's interface has been completely updated.
    5. All artworks for the epilogues are ready.
    6. All artworks for achievements are ready.
    7. Main images are being drawn, but they will be created closer to the release.
    8. We are in the process of creating images for lore articles. There will be 8 pieces (at least, that's the plan for now).

And now for the demonstration.

2. "Children of the Sun".
Add to wishlist.

I want to release it this year, but there's a good chance it won't happen on time. It's also quite a large project that should immerse you in the cosmogony of the world of Savvara.

Here we are working in a bunch of directions at once, but none of them have been completed yet.

We had a significant lag in terms of backgrounds. We had to change the artist in January 2024, but now several backgrounds are already ready. It is expected that there will be around 15-20.

notes.title: Annual report 2023
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/10ca08d3596f751fd81b37c37b64399e47055e0a.png

Hello!

You can follow us in Twitter, as well as Reddit.

And you can support me on Patreon.

It was a challenging, but eventful year.

We released "Gods of Savvarah | Part 1". I didn't want it to be released in this form. The original idea was not to split the game into parts, but unfortunately, circumstances forced us to do so.

Will there be a continuation for "Gods of Savvarah"? Let's be honest: I don't know.

We have material for a continuation. The artist who worked on this game and I are still working together. Moreover, we are very keen to complete the game, but unfortunately, we can't do that right now.

The reason is mundane: "Gods of Savvarah" took a lot of money, but didn't bring success or profits. Currently, we are working on other projects (outside of Savvarah). If they go well, then "Gods of Savvarah" might have a continuation. If not... Well, let's not think about the bad :)

Let me remind you what we have for the continuation. And there's a bonus at the very end.

For example, here are some fantastic views of Dai-Gra - the capital of Chazir, the Kingdom of the God Dadar.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/4a229cf4f6eb981d2ee6629ac658ffa2a14ce37e.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/cde29710b45d1d463c0ced1611943b77bdc8c5b2.png

And some characters from the continuation:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/bcc4df27565c09e8e8a2eaf8448a4a6d0379259b.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/691d1cfbdf11ecef97bff8a6e651a3a0a4c205b2.png

Now about the projects that 99 percent will be released next year:

1. Time of Pariah.
Just a reminder that the project has a Steam page and can be added to your Wishlist at this link. 

Scheduled for July-August 2024.

And so far, it feels like we have every chance to meet these dates.

What's done and what's not:

-  music is almost completely ready (currently, 6 original tracks are done);

-  interface stuff is almost completely ready: the map is done, there is a general vision. Rework is planned for the second half of January, and we've already found a person;

-  in the process of creating images for epilogues. Half of them are ready. Most likely, the work with epilogues will be finished in January;

-  art for one 18+ scene out of five is ready;

-  other images are in the process of creation, but as I said, we should be able to finish them;

-  the text is still in the proofreading stage. Most likely in February, we will start working on the translation;

-  achievements are planned. Expecting 41 achievements;

-   the text for notes, journal, and codex is not fully ready;

-  all images for character cards are ready.

Nevertheless, we did a good job this year.

"Time of the Pariah" is quite an ambitious project that I am very much looking forward to:

- crazy variability;

- cool characters;

- nice visuals.

Although I'm incredibly tired of writing the text (98 thousand words), honestly, I am satisfied with the work done.

You have already seen the covers and such, so just two images for the epilogues:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/c578f0cdb5e6a761f938db89ee0f44de0919145e.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/3ffbcbe2492133bc3dfa7442fb7454e75f140008.png

A couple of images you haven't seen:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/95fdbad35b84bb2601611e008cc4b107a0919d6a.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/2c0a2d8d8917cdddae3e967721f6ba1812cba83e.png

2. Children of the Sun. 
Just a reminder that the project has a Steam page and can be added to your Wishlist at this link. 

Scheduled for September-October 2024.

To be honest, I am not absolutely sure we can manage it, but again, there are good chances.

I am very much looking forward to this project, even though it almost killed me morally. More than 107 thousand words. And also great variability.

I'm a bit worried about "Children of the Sun" because the plot leaves a strange aftertaste, though I must say, I like my own work.

About what's happening:

- editing is not finished. I hope we will finish it in February. Then I'll start the translation;

- Work on the interface has not been conducted. Planned for February 2024;

- Also in the process of creating art for epilogues. Only one is ready so far, but I plan to finish them by early March 2024;

-  Locations are not ready. This is what I'm most worried about, but it seems like the current artist should speed up next year;

-  Images (scenes and others) are in the process of creation;

-  Music is completely ready (8 original tracks from Kvoh, who created the soundtrack for the chapter about Kalutu in "Gods of Savvara").

Unfinished image of one of the locations:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/6d86920d4838e7be04b33a39ca65eb051b6e9783.jpg

Image for one of the epilogues:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/4843beb64ccfcdbde790fbbb3ade3dc483dbd7ed.jpg

Some of the scenes:

And an image for the dead ends:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/6a978675f8e4c5b051d498bfacb16ab9de0eca51.png

3. Flowers and Scorpions..
Just a reminder that the project has a Steam page and can be added to your Wishlist at this link. 

I will write the least about this.

Flowers and Scorpions are postponed to 2025. The reason is simple: during editing, we decided that many moments are not working well. It needs text rework, which we don't have time for right now.

Nevertheless, much has been done for the project, including the soundtrack and numerous artworks. And we are not completely stopping the work.

For example, here is one of the future characters of the game named Mironega.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/fa8b04db6b12ded110d5b280625070b524968320.jpg

4. Additionally:
Book publishing house offered me to write a book about Savvarah and... Yes, create a coloring book.

I'm not sure when it will all be in English, but I still want to share.

Firstly, there will be a coloring book. And yes, it will be like a lore book, because there will be different peoples, individual heroes from games, and a bunch of gods and legendary personalities.

Here are some sketches without context:

In the book, you will see a story that, in a sense, became the starting point of the "Gods of Savvarah" story.

Also this year there have been many different articles on the nations of the Savvarah world:

Hello everyone! Thank you for following our work.

1. "Gods of Savvarah".
The situation has not changed significantly. We are still working on this project, but not very actively (let me remind you: the text is ready, music is ordered, some part of the art is already ready).

notes.content:
Hello everyone! Thank you for following our work.

You can follow us in Twitter, as well as Reddit.

The reports are dedicated to all projects in the world of "Savvarah" that are in progress (there are 4). Different people are working on all of them, so they do not interfere with each other. The projects are united by the world and the author.

Unfortunately, it could be said that June turned out to be not particularly productive due to artists being ill/going away and so on. Nevertheless, I have something to show and tell you.

1. Gods of Savvarah.
Nothing on them yet. We will most likely resume work in August/September because, as I said,  the team that was involved in development is now busy with another  project, unrelated to Savvarah.

notes.title: Savvarah Universe
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!
The world of Savvarah is not limited to what you see and will see in "Gods of Savvarah".
In addition to the fact that we are working on other projects (games) on the world of Savvarah, you can currently check out the Savvara world videos on our YouTube channel.

We have also started working on the comics, which are also about the world of Savvarah. They are currently temporarily frozen, but we hope to be able to continue working on them in the near future.
The comics are available to read:
- Tapas
- Webtoons

We can be supported on our Patreon.

You can also keep up with news and updates: 
- Our discord
- Out Twitter
- Our Subreddit.
